bookshelf.question: 一排摆为什么会自己走出波浪？

en.title: Release them together and watch a row of pendulums walk themselves into waves
en.posterTitle: Pendulums with different periods form a travelling wave

en.question: How does a whole field of fireflies suddenly flash together?

en.title: Metal salts grow into a mineral garden in solution
en.posterTitle: Drop a Metal Salt. Watch a Mineral Garden Grow.
en.posterHook: Osmotic pressure swells and ruptures a precipitate membrane; sometimes it reseals, growing lifeless salt into colored hollow tubes.
en.question: Why can a metal salt dropped into solution grow upward like a plant?

bookshelf.title: 神经网络通过调整权重学习分类
bookshelf.posterTitle: 神经网络用误差反向调整权重
bookshelf.posterHook: 换数据集、加深网络、改学习率——看决策边界怎样一点点贴上数据。

en.title: A neural network learns classification by adjusting weights
en.posterTitle: A neural network uses error to update its weights
en.posterHook: Swap datasets, deepen the net, change the learning rate — watch the decision boundary ease onto the data.
en.question: How do neural networks learn to classify from data?

bookshelf.title: 逆运动学根据末端位置计算机械臂关节
bookshelf.posterTitle: 末端目标位置决定各关节转角
bookshelf.posterHook: 拖住发光的手爪任意挪动——FABRIK 迭代像把绳子拉直再一节一节装回去；关节限位、肘上肘下双解、够不着就伸直指向，全是真的。
bookshelf.question: 你只说手要到哪儿，机械臂怎么知道每个关节转多少？

en.title: Inverse kinematics solves robot joints from an end position
en.posterTitle: An end-effector target determines each joint angle
en.posterHook: Drag the glowing gripper anywhere — FABRIK iterates like pulling a rope straight and reattaching it link by link. Joint limits, elbow-up and elbow-down branches, and an honest straight reach for what it cannot touch: all real.
en.question: You only say where the hand should go — how does the arm know how much each joint turns?

bookshelf.title: 此刻，整座太阳系
bookshelf.posterTitle: 八大行星此刻都在哪里？
bookshelf.posterHook: 任选一天，点任意行星跟拍：此刻它们各自在哪条轨道上。
bookshelf.question: 八大行星此刻都在哪里？

en.title: The solar system, right now
en.posterTitle: Where are the eight planets right now?
en.posterHook: Pick any day and follow any planet: see where each one sits on its orbit right now.
en.question: Where are the eight planets right now?

bookshelf.title: 三颗星，能跳出这么多完美的舞吗？
bookshelf.posterTitle: 三颗星，能跳出这么多完美的舞吗？
bookshelf.posterHook: 先看见离开地面的空间周期解。名解、蝴蝶和 8 字贴在一个平面上；2025 年的三维解会跳起来。点开一条，也可以亲手把它拧散。
bookshelf.question: 三颗星为什么能跳出花朵、蝴蝶和立体的舞？

en.title: Can three stars dance in so many perfect patterns?
en.posterTitle: Can three stars dance in so many perfect patterns?
en.posterHook: Spatial periodic orbits leave the plane first. Named dances, butterflies, and the figure-eight stay flat; the 2025 three-dimensional solutions lift off. Open one, or nudge it until it falls apart.
en.question: Why can three stars trace flowers, butterflies, and a dance in space?

bookshelf.title: 引力助推改变飞船的速度
bookshelf.posterTitle: 飞船如何不烧燃料，向行星「借」速度？
bookshelf.posterHook: 选择后方或前方掠过行星，亲眼看 Δv 为正还是为负；再切到旋转参考系，找引力刚好抵消的 5 个点。
bookshelf.question: 引力弹弓为什么能「白捡」速度？

en.title: A gravity assist changes a spacecraft’s speed
en.posterTitle: How can a spacecraft "borrow" speed from the planet without burning fuel?
en.posterHook: Choose to fly behind or in front of the planet and see with your own eyes whether Δv is positive or negative; then switch to the rotating reference frame and find 5 points where the gravity just cancels out.
en.question: Why can the gravity slingshot gain speed for free?

bookshelf.title: 曼德勃罗集边界的无限细节
bookshelf.posterTitle: 迭代公式生成自相似的分形边界
bookshelf.posterHook: 一个公式画出的宇宙：黑色是永远逃不出的点，彩色是逃逸快慢。放大边界，海马谷与螺旋层层展开——相似，却永不重复。
bookshelf.question: 为什么一个公式的边界，越放大越看不完？

en.title: Infinite detail along the Mandelbrot set boundary
en.posterTitle: An iterative formula produces a self-similar fractal boundary
en.posterHook: One formula paints a universe: black means trapped forever, color means how fast you escape. Zoom the boundary—seahorse valleys and spirals unfold, similar yet never the same.
en.question: Why does one formula’s boundary never run out as you zoom?

bookshelf.title: 猜错起点，答案会跳到另一边
bookshelf.posterTitle: 每个像素都在猜同一个方程的答案
bookshelf.posterHook: 用牛顿法从每个像素出发解 z³−1=0：颜色表示落到哪个解，白线是修正路径。
bookshelf.question: 同一个方程，为什么换个起点答案就变了？

en.title: Guess from the wrong start, and the answer jumps to another side
en.posterTitle: Every pixel is guessing the answer to the same equation
en.posterHook: Solve z³−1=0 from every pixel with Newton’s method: color shows which root you land on; the white line is the path of corrections.
en.question: Why does the same equation give different answers from different starting points?

bookshelf.title: 四个参数迭代生成 Clifford 吸引子
bookshelf.posterTitle: Clifford 映射形成确定性的点云结构
bookshelf.posterHook: Clifford 吸引子：每一步只是 sin 与 cos 的交错；十万次之后，翅膀、丝带与暗涡在纯黑里浮现。
bookshelf.question: 为什么四个数字反复迭代，会落成一片星云？

en.title: Four parameters generate a Clifford attractor
en.posterTitle: The Clifford map forms a deterministic point cloud
en.posterHook: Clifford attractor: each step is only interlaced sin and cos; after a hundred thousand steps, wings, ribbons, and dark eddies appear on pure black.
en.question: Why does iterating four numbers settle into a nebula?

bookshelf.title: 卡库亚针问题的最小转向区域
bookshelf.posterTitle: 单位线段可以在任意小面积内转向
bookshelf.posterHook: 最笨的办法是原地转一圈；更聪明的办法是贴着一条三尖形轨道滑过去。答案是：地方可以几乎为零——但再小也不能瘪成一条线。
bookshelf.question: 桌上有一根针要掉头，最少需要多大一块地方？

en.title: The minimum turning region in the Kakeya needle problem
en.posterTitle: A unit segment can turn inside a region of arbitrarily small area
en.posterHook: The clumsy way is to spin in place; a smarter way is to slide along a three-cusped track. The area can shrink to almost nothing—but it still cannot flatten into a single line.
en.question: A needle on a table needs to turn around—how little room does it need?

bookshelf.title: 状态轨迹形成奇异吸引子
bookshelf.posterTitle: 公式迭代出的奇异吸引子
bookshelf.posterHook: 六套方程各自规定「下一刻往哪走」；光点跟着跑，久了留下双翼、螺旋与空心球壳。

en.title: State trajectories form strange attractors
en.posterTitle: Strange attractors generated by iterated equations
en.posterHook: Six equation families each say where the state goes next; points follow the rules and leave wings, spirals, and hollow shells.
en.question: How are these shapes actually drawn?

bookshelf.title: 涡旋从流体扰动中产生并消散

en.title: Field lines trace the shape of an invisible electric force

bookshelf.title: 铁磁流体

en.question: Why does black liquid grow spikes when a magnet comes close?

bookshelf.title: 泳池焦散光纹

bookshelf.question: 为什么泳池底下的光一直在游？

en.title: Caustic light patterns in a pool
en.posterTitle: Moving caustic patterns on a pool floor
en.posterHook: Why does the light on a pool floor keep swimming?
en.question: Why does the light on a pool floor keep swimming?

bookshelf.title: 缩小一片叶隙，让树荫落满一百个太阳

bookshelf.title: 闪电沿分叉通道逐步前进

en.title: Lightning advances through a branching channel
en.posterTitle: Lightning forms a jagged path through branching channels

en.question: Why is lightning shaped like a jagged line?

bookshelf.title: 温度与湿度决定雪晶形状

en.posterHook: Each bird does just three things: avoid collisions, follow the flow, and stay with the group. The whole flock turns together.

bookshelf.question: 向日葵为什么把种子排成螺线？
